## Overview
### Introduction to Mistral Large 2411
The Mistral Large 2411 model, released by Mistral AI on 2024-11-12, is a standard-tier, non-open-source language model. This model is part of the Mistral AI offerings, with a specific pricing structure that includes input and output costs. Developers are charged $2.0 per 1M tokens for input and $6.0 per 1M tokens for output. The architecture of Mistral Large 2411 supports a context window of 131,072 tokens and can generate up to 4,096 tokens as output, with a knowledge cutoff of 2024-06.

### Technical Strengths and Use Cases
Mistral Large 2411 demonstrates its strengths through various benchmarks, including an MMLU score of 84.0, HumanEval score of 92.1, LMSYS Arena ELO of 1251, and a GSM8K score of 93.0. This model is best utilized for tasks such as coding, analysis, function calling, and content generation, among others. Its capabilities extend to text, vision, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and system prompts, making it a versatile tool for developers. However, it is not recommended for tasks that require embeddings, bulk cheap tasks, real-time sub-100ms responses, or vision-heavy applications.

### Pricing and Competitors
The pricing model for Mistral Large 2411 is based on input and output tokens, with examples showing that 1,000 calls (averaging 500 tokens) cost $4.0, scaling up to $400.0 for 100,000 calls. In comparison to its competitors, such as GPT-4o which charges $2.5/1M input and $10.0/1M output, Mistral Large 2411 offers a competitive pricing structure.
